topic.title: Semantic Embeddings and Their Geometry
topic.overview: Semantic embeddings represent words, texts, and concepts as vectors whose relationships support retrieval and downstream reasoning. These papers study efficient training, compositional structure, hierarchical representations, and interpretable directions. A central question is how statistical regularities in language produce the geometry observed in learned spaces.
topic.whyItMatters: Vector similarity can be useful without faithfully representing every semantic relationship. Understanding the training statistics and geometric constraints helps determine what an embedding preserves, which comparisons are meaningful, and when apparent structure is robust.
topic.evolution: Early representatives derive word spaces from co-occurrence and matrix factorization. Later work scales neural embeddings through contrastive estimation and compositional word-and-phrase models. Recent examples repurpose language models for embeddings, use sparse representations for interpretation, and connect recurring geometric patterns to symmetries in language statistics.
openQuestions: Which implicit meanings are systematically missed by surface-distribution objectives?
How can embedding geometry be compared across models without mistaking coordinate changes for semantic differences?

papers.tldr: A pretraining-focused evaluation finds that common embedding models select data less effectively than simple embeddings from models trained on the same corpus.

papers.title: Closed-Form Training Dynamics Reveal Learned Features and Linear Structure in Word2Vec-like Models
papers.tldr: An analytically solvable word2vec-like model reveals how topic and semantic subspaces emerge sequentially during training.

papers.title: Contextual Tokenization for Graph Inverted Indices
papers.tldr: CoRGII converts learned graph representations into indexable sparse codes, improving the measured trade-off between retrieval speed and accuracy.

papers.title: DETree: DEtecting Human-AI Collaborative Texts via Tree-Structured Hierarchical Representation Learning
papers.tldr: DETree organizes relationships among human–AI writing processes into a hierarchy to improve hybrid-text detection and generalization.

papers.title: Green Topics, Deep Roots: Energy-Aware Topic Modelling of Multilingual Nigerian Lyrics
papers.tldr: A comparison on multilingual Nigerian lyrics finds that classical topic models, especially NMF, offer a strong quality-energy trade-off.

papers.title: Harnessing the Universal Geometry of Embeddings
papers.tldr: Unsupervised embedding translation reveals shared geometry across models and enables sensitive attribute inference from vectors alone.

papers.title: Leveraging semantic similarity for experimentation with AI-generated treatments
papers.tldr: Double kernel representation learning compresses rich treatments and user characteristics into representations that support causal effect modeling and adaptive experimentation.

papers.title: On the Emergence of Linear Analogies in Word Embeddings
papers.tldr: A semantic-attribute generative model explains several observed ways that linear analogies emerge from word co-occurrence statistics.

papers.title: Semantic-KG: Using Knowledge Graphs to Construct Benchmarks for Measuring Semantic Similarity
papers.tldr: Semantic-KG generates structured meaning-comparison benchmarks and finds that similarity methods vary substantially across domains and semantic changes.

papers.title: Support Vector Generation: Kernelizing Large Language Models for Efficient Zero‑Shot NLP
papers.tldr: SVG builds efficient classifiers from frozen language-model embeddings, grounding each decision in at most 32 explicit support sentences.

papers.title: The Structure of Relation Decoding Linear Operators in Large Language Models
papers.tldr: Linear relation decoders share broad semantic properties, explaining their compressibility and transfer mainly to semantically similar relations.

papers.title: Gradients with Respect to Semantics Preserving Embeddings Tell the Uncertainty of Large Language Models
papers.tldr: SemGrad estimates language-model uncertainty without sampling by measuring sensitivity in embeddings chosen to preserve meaning.

papers.title: HypRAG: Hyperbolic Dense Retrieval for Retrieval Augmented Generation
papers.tldr: HypRAG uses hyperbolic embeddings and hierarchy-preserving pooling to improve retrieval and answer relevance in reported evaluations.

papers.title: Interpretable Embeddings with Sparse Autoencoders: A Data Analysis Toolkit
papers.tldr: Sparse-autoencoder embeddings make text analysis more interpretable and controllable while improving cost and reliability in the evaluated tasks.

papers.title: LEMUR: Learned Multi-Vector Retrieval
papers.tldr: LEMUR learns a reduction from multi-vector retrieval to single-vector search and reports an order-of-magnitude speedup over prior methods.

papers.title: ML-Embed: Inclusive and Efficient Embeddings for a Multilingual World
papers.tldr: ML-Embed combines three forms of model efficiency with multilingual training and open releases, setting records on 9 of 17 evaluated MTEB benchmarks.

papers.title: Polaris: Coupled Orbital Polar Embeddings for Hierarchical Concept Learning
papers.tldr: Polaris separates meaning and hierarchy in polar embeddings, improving reported parent retrieval across several taxonomy-expansion settings.

papers.title: Position: Text Embeddings Should Capture Implicit Semantics, Not Just Surface Meaning
papers.tldr: A pilot study motivates the paper’s call to train and evaluate text embeddings for implicit, contextual meaning.

papers.title: Symmetry in language statistics shapes the geometry of model representations
papers.tldr: Symmetries in language co-occurrence statistics explain simple embedding geometries and, under a latent-variable account, their robustness to perturbation.
